description: Start a test with a hypothesis: two or more variants of one variable on one surface. Paid tests are only allowed when the playbook allows spend. Variants become work; the numbers come back through outcomes. Returns the test's id; experiments_list shows it running and, once decided, its winner. It needs an act key.

hypothesis.description: What you expect and why, in one sentence.

metric.description: rate: the share who convert (clicks or sign-ups out of those who saw it); mean: an average amount per person (money, time).

minSample.description: People each variant needs before the test may be decided; at least 30.

name.description: A short name for the test.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

surface.description: Where it runs: paid (ads, only when the playbook allows spend), organic (the business's own posts), email or page (a landing page).

variable.description: The one thing that differs between the variants: a headline, a picture, a price, a send time.

variants.description: Two or more variants; the one keyed control, else the first, is the control.

description.description: What this variant is, in plain words.

key.description: A short key for the variant ('a', 'b', 'short-headline').

name: experiment_start
title: Experiment start
